messages:
emma-partnerships: Quick sync — we're planning to cut an Early Access marketplace listing for VoltScale this week. Need final check on seller creds, SKU bundling, EULA/legal, and a staging publish test across AWS/GCP/Azure. Anyone blocked?

mike-legal: I can do a pass on the EULA today. Do we have a draft from the partner or are we applying Redwood's standard publisher terms?

emma-partnerships: Partner sent a short addendum. Main ask is data residency clause for EU customers + a limited telemetry opt-out. I'll drop the addendum in the folder.

sophia-product: For packaging, VoltScale wants two SKUs: "VS-Std" (per-seat) and "VS-Compute" (GPU-hour). We also discussed a trial tier. Need SKU IDs and pricing matrix before staging.

jamie-ops: Staging accounts ready. We need publisher IAM email and a test marketplace account. Also confirm AMI/container image locations for AWS/GCP region mapping.

ravi-eng: FYI, the runtime team prefers we publish a lite quantized variant for the trial SKU to hit latency/cost targets. That means a separate model artifact tag in the manifest.

emma-partnerships: Good call. If we do two artifacts, we should map them to SKU variants. Example manifest snippet I propose for packaging:

```yaml
manifest:
  publisher: volt-scale
  skus:
    - id: VS-STD-001
      name: VS-Std
      billing: per_seat
      artifact: volt-v1-full
    - id: VS-TRIAL-001
      name: VS-Trial
      billing: trial
      artifact: volt-v1-quant
  regions: [us-east-1, europe-west1, asia-southeast1]
```

emma-partnerships: Thoughts?

mike-legal: That looks fine. I'll fold the partner addendum into our standard terms; flagging clause on telemetry (we might need explicit opt-out UX in the listing). Also need to confirm marketplace contract flow for refunds/trials.

sophia-product: UX call noted. I'll coordinate with docs to add the opt-out note on the listing page. Pricing matrix: attaching a quick table in the doc — will push final numbers by EOD.

jamie-ops: For infra, we need the container registry path + image tags. Also confirm if the partner will supply AMIs for AWS; if not we have to build from their OVA. Can someone tag the registry info here?

emma-partnerships: VoltScale provided GCR and ECR URIs in the drive. I'll paste them in the handoff doc.

ravi-eng: One technical ask: the quantized artifact needs a CPU fallback path. If the marketplace spins up on a CPU-only host, we should fallback to a compatible model or show an error. I'll prep the fallback policy config.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: marketplace preflight checklist due in 48h — https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace/onboarding-checklist

emma-partnerships: Action items: 1) @mike-legal — finish EULA + telemetry clause (due today). 2) @sophia-product — final pricing and trial UX note (EOD). 3) @jamie-ops — verify AMIs/registries + staging publish (tomorrow). 4) @ravi-eng — fallback policy and artifact tags (tomorrow morning). I'll consolidate and attempt a staging publish on Thursday.

mike-legal: On it. If I run into anything blocking the financial terms, will @mention finance.

sophia-product: Will update the doc and ping QA for acceptance criteria.

jamie-ops: I'll queue a staging deploy and share the runbook link once queued.

ravi-eng: Will add a short test plan for fallback (cold start, CPU failover, quantized correctness).

emma-partnerships: Thanks — let's aim to have the staging listing up and a quick smoke test before EOD Thursday. :tada:
